# DermSight: AI-Powered Skin Cancer Screening Mobile Application

## Project Introduction

DermSight is a sophisticated mobile application designed for community health workers to perform AI-powered skin cancer screening. The application provides offline-first functionality with intelligent lesion assessment, secure patient data management, and seamless cloud synchronization when connectivity is available.

### Core Goals and Objectives

- **AI-Powered Assessment**: On-device machine learning analysis of skin lesions using ABCD criteria (Asymmetry, Border, Color, Diameter)
- **Offline-First Architecture**: Complete functionality without internet connectivity, with automatic sync when online
- **Privacy & Security**: Local data storage with PIN-based authentication and encrypted secure storage
- **Community Health Focus**: Designed specifically for healthcare workers in resource-limited settings
- **Explainable AI**: Clear risk assessment with detailed scoring and confidence levels

### Target Audience

The application targets community health workers, nurses, and medical professionals who need reliable skin cancer screening capabilities in environments where internet connectivity may be unreliable or unavailable.

## Technical Architecture

The DermSight application follows a modern React Native architecture with Expo Router for navigation, Zustand for state management, and Drizzle ORM for local SQLite database operations.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[App Entry Point] --> B[Auth Layer]
    A --> C[Database Layer]
    A --> D[Feature Modules]
    
    B --> E[Secure Storage]
    B --> F[PIN Authentication]
    
    C --> G[SQLite Database]
    C --> H[Drizzle ORM]
    
    D --> I[Assessments Module]
    D --> J[Patients Module]
    D --> K[Sync Engine]
    
    I --> L[ML Inference]
    I --> M[Risk Assessment]
    
    K --> N[Supabase Integration]
    K --> O[Outbox Pattern]
    
    L --> P[TFLite Model]
```

### Component Breakdown

The application is structured around several key architectural layers:

1. **Presentation Layer**: React Native screens and components using NativeWind for styling
2. **Feature Layer**: Modular feature implementations (assessments, patients, auth, sync)
3. **Data Layer**: Local SQLite database with Drizzle ORM schema definitions
4. **Infrastructure Layer**: Network connectivity, secure storage, and external service integration

### Design Patterns

- **Repository Pattern**: Data access abstraction through repository classes
- **Outbox Pattern**: Reliable sync mechanism with retry logic
- **State Management**: Centralized state using Zustand stores
- **Feature-Based Architecture**: Modular organization by business domain

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

The application bootstrap process handles initialization of critical services:

- **Root Layout** (`src/app/_layout.tsx`): Initializes database, authentication state, and internationalization
- **Splash Screen** (`src/app/index.tsx`): Manages onboarding flow and routing based on authentication state
- **Authentication Store** (`src/features/auth/store.ts`): Handles user sessions and PIN-based security

### Core Modules

#### Database Schema (`src/db/schema.ts`)
The application uses a comprehensive SQLite schema with four main tables:
- **Users**: Health worker profiles with PIN hashes and Supabase integration
- **Patients**: Patient demographic information with location tracking
- **Assessments**: Detailed skin lesion analysis results with ABCD scoring
- **Sync Queue**: Outbox pattern implementation for reliable data synchronization

#### Assessment Repository (`src/features/assessments/repository.ts`)
Implements CRUD operations for skin lesion assessments with automatic sync queue integration:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant UI as User Interface
    participant Repo as Assessment Repository
    participant DB as SQLite Database
    participant Sync as Sync Queue
    
    UI->>Repo: createAssessment()
    Repo->>DB: Insert assessment record
    Repo->>Sync: Add to sync queue
    Repo-->>UI: Return assessment
    Sync->>DB: Mark as pending
```

#### Sync Engine (`src/features/sync/syncEngine.ts`)
Background synchronization system with exponential backoff retry logic:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Start Sync] --> B{Network Available?}
    B -->|No| C[Skip Pending Items]
    B -->|Yes| D[Get Pending Items]
    D --> E[Process Each Item]
    E --> F{Upload Success?}
    F -->|Yes| G[Mark as Done]
    F -->|No| H{Retry Count < Max?}
    H -->|Yes| I[Increment Retry + Backoff]
    H -->|No| J[Mark as Failed]
    G --> K[Next Item]
    I --> K
    J --> K
    K --> L{More Items?}
    L -->|Yes| E
    L -->|No| M[Complete]
```

### Configuration Approach

The application uses multiple configuration strategies:

- **Environment Configuration**: Expo configuration files for platform-specific settings
- **Theme System**: Tailwind CSS with custom color schemes and design tokens
- **Internationalization**: Multi-language support with i18next integration
- **Model Management**: Versioned ML model deployment and switching

### External Dependencies

Key dependencies include:

- **React Native & Expo**: Cross-platform mobile development framework
- **Zustand**: Lightweight state management solution
- **Drizzle ORM**: Type-safe database queries for SQLite
- **Supabase**: Backend-as-a-service for cloud synchronization
- **TFLite**: TensorFlow Lite for on-device machine learning inference
- **NativeWind**: Tailwind CSS integration for React Native

### Integration Points

The application integrates with several external systems:

- **Supabase**: Cloud database and authentication backend
- **Camera System**: Device camera for lesion image capture
- **Location Services**: GPS coordinates for patient records
- **File System**: Secure local storage for images and documents
- **Secure Storage**: Encrypted PIN and sensitive data storage

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

#### AI-Powered Lesion Assessment
The core assessment engine analyzes skin lesions using the ABCD criteria:

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> ImageCapture
    ImageCapture --> Preprocessing
    Preprocessing --> MLInference
    MLInference --> ABCDScoreCalculation
    ABCDScoreCalculation --> RiskClassification
    RiskClassification --> ResultDisplay
    ResultDisplay --> [*]
    
    MLInference --> Error: Model Not Available
    Error --> ResultDisplay
```

#### Offline-First Data Management
Local-first architecture ensures functionality without internet connectivity:

- Real-time local database operations
- Background synchronization when network becomes available
- Conflict resolution and data consistency mechanisms
- Automatic retry with exponential backoff

#### Secure Authentication System
Multi-layered security approach:

- PIN-based authentication with hashed storage
- Session management with automatic timeout
- Secure storage for sensitive credentials
- Optional biometric authentication support

### Implementation Highlights

#### Camera Integration (`src/app/(app)/patients/[patientId]/capture.tsx`)
Guided camera interface with framing guides and quality tips:

- Real-time camera preview with overlay guides
- Lighting and positioning assistance
- Multiple capture modes (photo/guide)
- Quality assessment feedback

#### Risk Assessment Engine (`src/features/assessments/inference/classify.ts`)
Sophisticated ML inference pipeline:

- Mock inference system ready for TFLite model integration
- ABCD score calculation (Asymmetry, Border, Color, Diameter)
- Risk tier classification (low, medium, high, urgent referral)
- Confidence scoring and probability distribution

#### Synchronization System (`src/features/sync/syncEngine.ts`)
Robust background sync with reliability guarantees:

- Outbox pattern for guaranteed delivery
- Exponential backoff retry mechanism
- Network connectivity detection
- Conflict resolution strategies

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[User Input] --> B[Assessment Engine]
    A --> C[Patient Management]
    A --> D[Data Sync]
    
    B --> E[ML Processing]
    B --> F[Risk Analysis]
    B --> G[Result Storage]
    
    C --> H[CRUD Operations]
    C --> I[Validation]
    C --> J[Image Management]
    
    D --> K[Queue Management]
    D --> L[Network Handling]
    D --> M[Conflict Resolution]
    
    E --> N[TFLite Model]
    F --> O[ABCD Scoring]
    G --> P[SQLite Storage]
```

The DermSight application represents a well-architected mobile health solution that balances advanced AI capabilities with practical offline functionality. Its modular design, robust error handling, and focus on user privacy make it suitable for deployment in diverse healthcare environments where reliability and accessibility are paramount.

- [Sync Engine](src/features/sync/syncEngine.ts)
- [ML Classification](src/features/assessments/inference/classify.ts)
